Introducing the Melon Fruit 3D asset, meticulously scanned indoors using a specialized photogrammetry setup. This pack offers three versions to suit your specific needs:

  - Lower Poly Version: With just 512 quads, this version ensures efficient rendering while retaining the essential details of the melon fruit.

  - Mid Poly Version: Comprised of 4096 quads, this model provides a balance between detail and performance. It is wrapped to the high-density scan, capturing the intricate features of the fruit.

  - Raw Photoscan in Blend File: Included in the pack is the raw photoscan itself, embedded within the blend file. This gives you direct access to the original data, allowing for further customization and manipulation as desired.

All textures included in this asset pack are 2K resolution, ensuring high-quality visuals. The normal map, specifically, is a 16-bit TIFF baked from the 4 million+ faces of the scan. This results in a precise and accurate representation of the melon fruit's surface details.
Immerse yourself in the world of realism with the Melon Fruit 3D asset. Whether you need a lower poly option for efficiency or a mid poly model for enhanced details, this pack has you covered. Download now and unlock the potential of lifelike melon fruit in your projects.

The tropics are a region of the Earth surrounding the Equator. They are delimited in latitude by the Tropic of Cancer in the Northern Hemisphere at 23°26′12.7″ (or 23.43687°) N and the Tropic of Capricorn in the Southern Hemisphere at 23°26′12.7″ (or 23.43687°) S; these latitudes correspond to the axial tilt of the Earth. The tropics are also referred to as the tropical zone and the torrid zone (see geographical zone). The tropics include all the areas on the Earth where the Sun contacts the zenith, a point directly overhead, at least once during the solar year (which is a subsolar point).The tropics are distinguished from the other climatic and biomatic regions of Earth, which are the middle latitudes and the polar regions on either side of the equatorial zone.The tropics comprise 40% of the Earth's surface area and contain 36% of the Earth's landmass. As of 2014, the region is home to 40% of the world population, and this figure is projected to reach 50% by the late 2030s.

Drying is a mass transfer process consisting of the removal of water or another solvent by evaporation from a solid, semi-solid or liquid. This process is often used as a final production step before selling or packaging products. To be considered dried, the final product must be solid, in the form of a continuous sheet (e.g., paper), long pieces (e.g., wood), particles (e.g., cereal grains or corn flakes) or powder (e.g., sand, salt, washing powder, milk powder). A source of heat and an agent to remove the vapor produced by the process are often involved. In bioproducts like food, grains, and pharmaceuticals like vaccines, the solvent to be removed is almost invariably water. Desiccation may be synonymous with drying or considered an extreme form of drying.{Wiki}

description_text:
This Free Low Poly Forest Nature Pack contains 34 assets out of 2228 unique assets from the Ultimate Low Poly Nature Pack and allows you to build your own forest!
New in version 3.0

  -     Unity package: Terrain map (250x250) with thousands of hand-placed objects

  -     11 new meshes added from the full package

This free pack contains 1% of the assets present in the Ultimate Low Poly Nature Pack.
The package contains one list scene and one demo scene.
The full package is available following this link: 
https://www.cgtrader.com/3d-models/exterior/landscape/ultimate-low-poly-nature-pack-43eb4122-5dcd-450b-9329-cd7f6d6641ec
Polycount
The overall polygon count varies from 67 tris (Floor Tile) to 1946 tris (Mountain), the average triangle count is 890 tris.
Texture
All models share the same 256x256 texture to increase performance and are ready to use for your PC/Mobile game and VR/AR experience.
Package files
This package comes with all individual fbx files (34x), two fbx files with the demo scene and the list scene  as well as a Unity package that contains all prefabs and the demo scene.
Package content

  - Terrain Tiles (Meadow, Lake) (4x): 515 – 1818 tris (average 1384 tris)

  - Mountains (2x): 1830 – 1946 tris (average 1888 tris)

  - Flowers (Hyacinth, Sunflower, Daffodil) (3x): 848 – 1796 tris (average 1399 tris)

  - Grass (2x): 440 – 534 tris (average 487 tris)

  - Rocks (4x): 376 – 576 tris (average 494 tris)

  - Mushrooms (4x): 416 – 660 tris (average 574 tris)

  - Trees (Birch Trees, Fir Trees)(4x): 1520 – 1890 tris (average 1673 tris)

Added in version 3.0

  - Bridge parts (3x): 792 - 904 tris (average 853 tris)

  - Fences (2x): 400 - 716 tris (average 558 tris)

  - Pebbles (2x): 440 - 442 tris (average 441 tris)

  - Floor Tiles (4x): 62 - 68 tris (average 67 tris)
